segments.name: Balloon products
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and distributes balloon products worldwide, plus laminated and converted films for packaging.
segments.evidence: We manage our business activities as a single segment as our business contains similar products and services managed by the Company, and are economically similar, and share similar types of customers, production and distribution.
